title: Canyons 100K — Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB 2027
publisher: UTMB World Series / Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB
claims: The 100K is 100 KM with 3,750 m of gain, starts at China Wall Trailhead on Saturday 24 April 2027 at 05:00 and has a 20-hour limit; it carries 6 Running Stones and lists Finals Access 100k-direct-entry-major. The English locale displays 62.1 miles and 12,303 ft+.
The course description says the route has approximately 13,000 ft of gain and 17,000 ft of descent, while the header gives 3,750 m+ (about 12,303 ft).

The 2027 page states that its GPX file and aid-station chart are the 2026 versions and are subject to change for 2027; the GPX link returned HTTP 200 and 333,185 bytes and was downloaded on 2026-11-20 for local measurement, not redistribution.

The route runs from China Wall via Mitchell Mine Rd and Eldorado Canyon to Deadwood, Swinging Bridge, Devil's Thumb, Michigan Bluff, Volcano Canyon, Foresthill, Cal Street, the American River, Drivers Flat, Mammoth Bar, Confluence, No Hands Bridge and Robie Point to downtown Auburn.
The 2026 100K aid chart lists drop bags at Foresthill and Drivers Flat and crew access at Deadwood-2, Michigan Bluff and Foresthill; Swinging Bridge is marked N/A with no aid.
